name: Dawn Mosque
summary: A warm sunrise behind an ivory mosque brings a sense of hope and a fresh beginning.
why: The gold half-sun gives the mark a morning horizon. A low central dome, two compact minarets, and a cut-out entrance keep the mosque clear. The balanced, wide composition feels grounded and optimistic.
risk: The sunrise emphasizes dawn and renewal; the mosque carries the prayer identity.
reasonToChoose: You want a welcoming mosque and the feeling of a fresh beginning.
